text: I've been trying to get through on the phone for three days just to book a routine appointment.
The GP dismissed my symptoms and it turned out to be something much more serious that another doctor caught.
Nobody called me back about my results like they said they would, I had to chase it myself.
The receptionist was incredibly rude and made me feel like a burden for asking a question.
My repeat prescription still hasn't been sent to the pharmacy after a week.
My referral letter to the specialist never seems to have been sent, the hospital has no record of it.
Excellent, caring practice, the whole team always goes above and beyond. Thank you!
